incumbent_comparison: The preceding v002 attempt is retained but fails the measured dimensional tolerance (Godot reports 24 x 10.37 x 20.15 inches against the brief 24 x 13 x 20 inches), so there is no valid rendered incumbent to compare. v003 responds with a roof vent/cap to correct the height and records the first technically passing production render; it reads as a loading shed with hoist and strapped supplies.
next_action_hypothesis: Promote depot-v003 as the stable supply-depot visual; preserve RoomDefinition-owned storage, construction state, and landmark placement.

observations.art_direction_fit: A timber-and-copper supply shed with a rail hoist belongs in the detailed miniature clockwork settlement and is more specific than the prior box-like placeholder.
observations.close_up_quality: The close capture exposes the crates and barrel construction plus the loading pulley; the three-quarter view still reads the canopy as one continuous covering plane.
observations.gameplay_readability: The production path attaches the asset to the existing RoomDefinition depot landmark; no generated mesh is used as storage/construction gameplay state.
observations.geometric_detail: Run-003 detail and opposite views show crate straps/rivets, plank courses, awning seams, corner braces, hoist chain/pulley, vent, counter frame, and barrel hoops.
observations.material_realism: Warm timber, dark iron, copper awning, stone plinth, and amber counter glass respond differently to the current key/fill lighting in run-003.
observations.proportion: The technical report measures 24 x 13.08 x 20.15 inches against the 24 x 13 x 20 inch target, within the factory's dimensional tolerance.
observations.scale_fidelity: The measured bounds match the brief, and the settlement-scale capture shows the 0.6-scaled building alongside active citizens.
observations.semantic_recognizability: Run-003 asset and settlement captures identify an open-front storehouse with a raised base, timber rear wall, metal canopy, counter opening, rail, pulley, crates, and barrel.
observations.silhouette_quality: The canopy and two front posts form a legible depot silhouette; the open front preserves visibility into the loading area.
observations.surface_variation: Wood courses and crate bands vary in color and roughness; repeated crates remain intentionally family-consistent instead of identical flat cubes.
observations.technical_integration: Godot 4.7.2 technical validation passes and run-003 receipt identifies the exact depot candidate and scene path with production_path=true.
